text:
elena: heads up — alert flood from notify-orch but incidentbot didn't page oncall for ~5m. PD shows no webhook deliveries for those alerts. anyone looking?

sam: seeing lots of 502/504 to pagerflow webhooks from notify-proxy. also a bunch of failed deliveries in the notify-orch metrics.

jessica: I'm oncall, missed the pages. I only got a slack DM from incidentbot but no page. CS just flagged two enterprise customers with escalations delayed.

ops-bot: logs snippet from notify-proxy (tail):
```
2026-03-17T16:40:12Z notify-proxy request to pagerflow timed out (504) id=abc123
2026-03-17T16:40:13Z notify-proxy request to pagerflow timed out (504) id=abc124
2026-03-17T16:40:14Z notify-proxy backend connection reset id=abc125
```

raj: attempted manual webhook POST -> getting 504 from pagerflow: `curl -v -X POST https://pagerflow.example/webhook -d '{"id":"test"}'` returns gateway timeout.

elena: can someone check the notify consumer queue and proxy pod health? `kubectl get pods -n notify` and `kubectl logs deploy/notify-proxy -n notify --since=10m`

sam: quick check:`kubectl get pods -n notify` shows notify-proxy-0 CrashLoopBackOff, notify-proxy-1 Running, notify-proxy-2 Running. pulls show CPU spike then timeout. pasted kube events: "Back-off restarting failed container" around 16:35.

incidentbot: automated: webhook delivery failures for service "notify" exceeded threshold -> suppressor active for 10m (policy: repeated-delivery-failures). pages suppressed: 42.

jessica: that's the reason. suppressor auto-suppressed pages after multiple failed fanout attempts. We need to force pages for sev=critical. Can we clear the suppressor state?

raj: we can clear the suppressor via admin endpoint but need admin token. propose: 1) restart the failing proxy canary 2) clear suppressor 3) force re-send critical alerts.

elena: note we rotated pagerflow signing keys last night — could be related, but logs here are timeouts not auth failures. still worth verifying token acceptance.

sam: checked auth logs — no 401s. mostly timeouts and connection resets. looks infra/back-end latency at pagerflow or a routing flap.

raj: doing a canary restart now: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/notify-proxy -n notify --selector=notify-canary=true`

ops-bot: rollout status: 
```
deploy/notify-proxy paused -> updating
deploy/notify-proxy resumed -> new pod running
new pod ready
```

sam: after restart fanout throughput improved but incidentbot is still in suppressed state (it records past suppression window). how do we clear?

elena: admin endpoint: `POST https://console.internal/admin/suppressor/clear?service=notify` — requires admin bearer token. someone with access run it.

jessica: i have admin access, running clear now.

jessica: ran `POST /admin/suppressor/clear?service=notify` -> 200 OK. attempting to re-deliver queued critical alerts.

incidentbot: automated: suppressor state cleared for service "notify". retrying queued deliveries: 18/18 delivered to oncall.

elena: confirmed pages sent. CS notified that pages resumed; need to coordinate customer comms for the 5-10m delay. ticket INC-5822 created.

sam: followups and notes:
- root cause likely transient downstream routing/timeouts at pagerflow endpoint -> manifested as delivery failures -> suppressor kicked in.
- signing-key rotation likely unrelated but will verify in postmortem.
- suppression policy thresholds too aggressive for short transients, consider raising threshold or adding a fast-fail healthcheck to avoid long suppression on infra timeouts.

raj: created follow-up ticket ENG-1194 to add healthcheck and tune suppressor. also adding an alert when suppressor suppresses >0 critical events for >1m.

jessica: i'll draft customer-facing note for the impacted tenants and loop in CS.

elena: thanks everyone. action items:
1) eng-sre to investigate proxy crashloops and root cause (raj + sam)
2) notify team to validate signing rotation and add healthcheck (sam)
3) infra to add suppressor-alert + adjust thresholds (raj)
4) postmortem and customer comms (jessica)

elena: marking thread tracked — please paste PR/incident doc link here when created. closing once postmortem and comms are done. :thumbsup:
